title: Export the genetic algorithm results
description: You distinguish the JSON summary from the array archive.

steps.description: You create artifacts and build a summary of best_x, best_fitness, and configuration. Array and NumPy scalar conversions prepare those values for JSON.
You serialize summary to ga_summary.json. indent=2 formats the object for reading.

steps.question: Where does this example save the full final population?
steps.answer: It saves pop under final_pop in ga_logs_and_population.npz. The same archive includes final fitness and both histories.

steps.description: You finish by listing the artifacts directory. The recording names ga_logs_and_population.npz and ga_summary.json.
